text.tspan: Same runs, two indexes, two different questions.
Left: after finishing task k, how the model does on the k−1 tasks behind it — the state of the whole system as the sequence grows.
Right: every task that is n phases old, pooled whenever it occurred — the life of a single task.
A method can be flat on the left and still decaying on the right, if the later tasks were easier.
The right panel is where ours differs in kind: it starts lowest at age 0 and is the only curve that rises.
Complete runs only — ours 3 seeds, the others 1 each.
